title: EGGROLL Swarm Retraining Architecture
summary: Defines a swarm-native retraining layer for GeniusCognitiveSystem using EGGROLL-style evolutionary optimization with deterministic perturbation reconstruction, compact fitness communication, and reputation-gated promotion.
notes: Document defines architectural design principles, execution models, fitness packet format, and a phased rollout plan — placing it between SPEC and DOC. Classified as SPEC because it prescribes how the retraining layer should be built, though it lacks formal API contracts or protocol definitions. No markdown links to other doc files found.
